answer: Prayers & Duties >> Oaths & Vows Question ID: 28370 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: For some bad habits (gunah)i have aahed (promise)to ALLAH that i will not do it again in my life but it hapens again i promise again so what is the kaffara for the break of promise for many times. Question: Asslam alykum For some bad habits (gunah)i have aahed (promise)to ALLAH that i will not do it again in my life but it hapens again i promise again so what is the kaffara for the break of promise for many times. Answer ID: 28370 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 45/45/M=1432) If the promise to Allah means that you swore and said: "In swear Allah, I will not commit such sin in my life again", it took place. When you committed that sin, you broke your oath. Now it is necessary to pay its kaffarah. As much as oath you would break, that much kaffarah would be wajib. The kaffarah of oath is to feed ten poor persons two times meal or to give them dresses. And, if one is unable to do so he should keep three fasts consecutively. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
